caption:
A skater performs an ice routine.
Seedance 2.5 delivered flawless anime animation.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 20 seconds, 16:9, Japanese anime film aesthetic, Makoto Shinkai atmospheric lighting, dynamic ice-level tracking, fluid and graceful pacing.

CHARACTERS:
THE SKATER: 17-year-old female figure skater, large luminous blue anime eyes, long flowing silver-lavender hair, wearing an ethereal crystal-embellished light-blue dress with a feathered skirt and white skates.

LOCATION:
OLYMPIC ICE RINK: Professional indoor arena, polished reflective ice illuminated by cool blue spotlights, blurred crowd in the darkened background.

SHOTS:
SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:02.1) — Face Focus. Extreme close-up pulling back slowly from THE SKATER's face. Her glowing blue eyes gaze forward with calm focus under arena lights. MUST SHOW: Glowing blue anime eyes.
SHOT 2 (00:02.1-00:02.7) — Dress Detail. Close tracking shot moving down past her sparkling crystal bodice and layered feather skirt.
SHOT 3 (00:02.7-00:03.3) — Leg Glide. Low tracking shot following her legs gliding in forward stride across the smooth ice.
SHOT 4 (00:03.3-00:04.0) — Skate Blade. Ice-level profile tracking shot of a single white skate boot gliding on steel blade.
SHOT 5 (00:04.0-00:05.1) — Footwork Edge. Low frontal tracking shot of both skate boots carving curved tracks into the surface.
SHOT 6 (00:05.1-00:10.8) — Spiral and Sit Spin. Wide orbiting camera tracks THE SKATER as she extends into an arabesque spiral, transitions through crossovers, and drops into a fast sit spin with forward leg extended. MUST SHOW: Low sit spin with extended skate.
SHOT 7 (00:10.8-00:11.6) — Blade Carve. Close-up cut of the skate blade cutting deep into the ice, kicking up fine ice crystals.
SHOT 8 (00:11.6-00:18.4) — Jumps and Pose. Wide dynamic tracking shot as she launches into technical jumps, lands cleanly on one blade, and glides backward into an outstretched final pose under overhead spotlights.
SHOT 9 (00:18.4-00:20.1) — Final Bow. Medium close-up of THE SKATER exhaling, lifting her head, and smiling warmly into the camera with her hand over her heart.

SOUND: Soaring orchestral piano and violin melody, crisp metallic skate blade cuts on ice, rushing wind, and arena crowd applause swelling at the finish.
prompt_short: A skater performs a graceful ice routine. Feature anime film style. A silver-haired figure skater in a crystal blue dress executes spirals, spins, and jumps across an arena ice rink, finishing with a radiant smile.
